items.title: Tata Motors registers highest monthly sales in October: 73,894 units
items.summary: Tata Motors, the current No. 2 passenger vehicle manufacturer after Maruti Suzuki and ahead of Mahindra & Mahindra, has registered its highest monthly wholesales in October.

items.title: New Sorento Midsize SUV Sells 1,739 Units in First Month, Kia India Sales Grow 29% in H1 FY2027
items.summary: The new Kia Sorento midsize SUV, launched on September 4, has sold 1,739 units in its first full month of wholesales (factory dispatches) in the domestic market. Kia India’s new ICE-powered flagship SUV, which was the fifth highest-selling model for the company last month, contributed 5% to Kia India’s record monthly sales in September.

items.title: Passenger Vehicle Retail Sales Fall 14.23% To 5.08 Lakh In October: FADA
items.summary: Passenger vehicle retail sales in India fell 14.23 percent year on year to 5,07,768 units in October 2026, according to FADA. Volumes rose 18.86 percent from 4,27,213 units in September.

items.title: Volkswagen Taigun sells 100,000 units in India and 52,751 overseas since launch
items.summary: The Volkswagen Taigun, which turned five years old last month after its launch in September 2021 , has surpassed the 100,000-units domestic market sales milestone. As per SIAM wholesales numbers, the midsize SUV has sold 99,095 units till end-September 2026.

items.title: Tata Altroz Drives Past 350,000 Sales, Contributes 34% to Tata Car Sales Since Launch
items.summary: The Tata Altroz has surpassed the 350,000-unit wholesales milestone in the Indian market. As per SIAM wholesales data, Tata Motors’ premium hatchback had clocked total sales of 349,185 units till the end of September 2026.

items.title: Eurogrip Showcases New Tyre Lines at EICMA and SEMA Exhibitions
items.summary: Eurogrip Tyres participating in the SEMA Show 2026 in Las Vegas from November 3 to 6 and EICMA 2026 in Milan from November 3 to 8, marking its sixth consecutive appearance at the motorcycle exhibition. At EICMA, the brand unveiled the Protorq Max SuperSport tyre, the Bee Sport scooter tyre, the Explo-R Plus adventure touring tyre, and the Altai prototype series for medium and large adventure motorcycles.

items.title: Hero Vida e-scooter sales soar to new high in October, cross 200,000 for the first time in CY2026
items.summary: Even as October draws to a close in two days, Hero MotoCorp has already registered its highest monthly retail sales and has also crossed cumulative year-to-date sales of 200,000 units for the first time in a calendar year. In the first 29 days of this month, 27,435 Vida e-scooters have been delivered to customers, marking strong 66% YoY growth (October 2025: 16,499 units).

items.title: Tata Motors Leads CV Retails with Over 39,000 Units and 35% Market Share
items.summary: Tata Motors secured the leading position in India's commercial vehicle retail market for October 2026, registering 39,914 units and capturing a 34.67 percent market share. The company's retail performance was an improvement on its 31.89 percent market share from 35,901 units recorded in October 2025.

items.title: Tractor Retail Sales Rise 3.10% To 79,285 Units In October: FADA
items.summary: Tractor retail sales in India rose 3.10% year on year to 79,285 units in October 2026, according to FADA. Retails were up 3.09% from 76,906 units in September.

items.title: Three-Wheeler Retail Sales Rise 3.97% To 1.41 Lakh In October; Best-Ever October: FADA
items.summary: Three-wheeler retail sales in India rose 3.97% YoY to 1,41,420 units in October 2026, according to FADA. Retails were up 6.68% from 1,32,570 units in September.

items.title: Commercial Vehicle Retail Sales Rise 2.29% To 1.15 Lakh In October: FADA
items.summary: Commercial vehicle retail sales in India rose 2.29% YoY to 1,15,140 units in October 2026, according to FADA. Retails were up 11.19 percent from 1,03,557 units in September.

items.title: Bajaj Chetak Becomes Third Indian Electric Scooter OEM to Cross 10 Lakh Sales
items.summary: Bajaj Auto has become the third Indian electric two-wheeler manufacturer, after Ola Electric and TVS Motor Co to achieve the one-million (10 lakh) retail sales milestone in India. Since launch in January 2020, the Pune-based manufacturer of the Chetak e-scooter has delivered 10,01,135 units to its customers in the domestic market (see data table below).

items.title: Tube Investments Approves Rs 83 Cr Capex for Avadi Capacity Expansion
items.summary: Tube Investments of India Ltd has approved a capital expenditure of up to ₹83 crore to enhance manufacturing capacity at its existing cold rolled steel strips (CRSS) facility in Avadi, Tamil Nadu, as it looks to meet increasing demand. The project, which falls under the company's Engineering division, is expected to be completed in FY28.

items.title: Maruti Suzuki’s SUV, MPV share of PV sales at 42% in H1 FY2027 with 455,692 units
items.summary: Passenger vehicle market leader Maruti Suzuki India has crossed the 1-million wholesales mark for the first time in the first-half of a fiscal in April-September 2026. The 10,80,240 units are a handsome 36% YoY increase and the result of a revival in demand for its cars and sedans following GST 2.0 price reductions and, importantly, the big jump in sales of its utility vehicles comprising SUVs and MPVs.

items.title: Navratri Sales Dip 5% on High Base Effect
items.summary: Vehicle retail sales during this year’s Navratri window slipped about 5% from last year, when the festival began on the same day that revised GST rates took effect, according to data released by the Federation of Automobile Dealers Associations (FADA). Retailers sold 11,40,658 vehicles between 11 and 20 October 2026, against 12,01,480 in the 2025 window, a fall of 5.06%.

items.title: Gabriel India's PV Suspension Business Lags Industry Growth in H1, Sees Opportunities in Sunroofs and ADAS
items.summary: Gabriel India's passenger vehicle (PV) suspension business has lagged industry growth during the first half of FY27, as an unfavourable vehicle-model mix prevented the company from fully benefiting from strong demand. The company’s management said demand for smaller cars had improved following changes in GST, but Gabriel had limited exposure to some of the faster-growing models.
